source: User-supplied manuscript: LUMI: Efficient Large MoE Inference on a Single Laptop GPU

cache_grid.notes: First 200 decode forwards; source precision; stock performance profile; experimental 6 GiB host floor. GPU budget includes dense weights. Other cells have one process; no confidence intervals inferred.

mechanisms.table: IV; final boundary row refined using Table X
mechanisms.notes: Each row has its own frozen control and three alternating pairs. Last two rows change capacity with execution. Rows are not independent single-feature ablations and must not be chained into cumulative speedup.

wall_partition.notes: Exclusive wall-time buckets in ms/token. Other includes queued GPU/DMA dependencies, not just CPU compute. Printed buckets can differ from printed totals by 0.01 ms due to rounding.
